evidence.claim: Totals read from the local copy of the served table for 2026-05-06: 826 securities, 459 with every position row null, 10,090 rows, 6,122 null rows; 0 securities partly priced
price_source on the date: 3,358 cottonwood-silver-canonical-prices, 608 cash-at-par, 2 etfs-bbg-testpull-ticker-history, 6,122 null
Asset_Type per CUSIP from the silver transactions cache: one value per CUSIP, none missing, all 826 CUSIPs present (14 files, 1,416,497 rows)
The build's universe reads only Cusip, Symbol, Trade_Date of the transactions; no Amount is read for pricing

The price stores the build reads: six, in order (own silver canonical prices; own gold canonical holdings, 'the custodian mark on a held position'; rivalfunds-etfs-gold-security-market; etfs-bbg-testpull-ticker-history; etfs-bbg-fund-daily; portal-canon-return-daily-values)
evidence.file: data/assets/scripts/analysis/commonwealth_price_census.py (the file the order names as silver/commonwealth_price_census.py)

evidence.claim: The build loops over exactly those stores (and the optional --sechist series) and values a holding only at that day's close, no carry-forward
Match rule: CUSIP first, then a ticker no other CUSIP claims; a multiply-claimed ('reused') ticker is returned as ticker_reused and not credited
The custodian's positions table has 11 vendor columns, Quantity the only numeric; no price or market value
The custodian's performance table has 13 columns: returns and benchmark values per account-period, no security key
Prior statement in the repo: the delivery holds no reported market or position value; the one outside level is the price paid (|Amount|/|Quantity| of by/sl/dvr rows, 5-day window)

Local silver positions copy: 469 rows, one AsOfDate 2026-06-23, 105 CUSIPs (54 of the 459 unpriced); columns Advisor_ID, AccountNumber, Cusip, FundCode, Symbol, Security_Description, Quantity, LongShort_Indicator, Position_Type, AsOfDate, Account_Status plus 5 lineage columns

Local copies of the six stores' priced rows (universe hash 16278a1c4f6b): gold canonical holdings 564,563 rows spanning 2026-06-08 to 2026-10-06; silver canonical prices 2,138,920 rows spanning 2020-06-30 to 2026-06-09; rivalfunds 95 rows; etfs-bbg-testpull 132,015; etfs-bbg-fund-daily 0; portal-canon 0
Positive control for the store reads: of the 367 priced securities the cached silver store prices 366 on the date by the build's match rule (the 367th is the cash security at par)

Gold canonical holdings (the custodian mark on a held position) holds CUSIP-keyed rows for 428 of the 459 unpriced securities, all on dates 2026-06-08 to 2026-10-06, so none on 2026-05-06 or within 5 days
The Yahoo cache is read by the build only for the substitute-class tickers of the first store
PRD: Yahoo Finance for equity, ETF and fund securities; Bloomberg at site Z for fixed income and other; a security neither source prices leaves its days UNPRICED
Asset-type grouping for the ruled source: fund = Mutual Fund, Mutual Fund (Closed End), Unit Investment Trust; fixed income = Fixed Income; other = everything else
The price-need file is read-only and fetches nothing (fetched=0)

not_established: Whether the 32 unpriced securities (Equity 22, ETF 9, Mutual Fund 1; 426 of the 6,122 unpriced position rows) that have a price row on the date under a symbol listed by more than one CUSIP in the transaction history are priced CORRECTLY by that row. Settling read: the Symbol history per CUSIP by date from the silver transactions (which CUSIP traded under the symbol around 2026-05-06), joined to the 32 rows. In all 32 the other claiming CUSIP is not held on the date, so the price is not already taken by a priced position.

The store content is read from local caches dated 2026-10-08 (fwd3/price_cache, universe hash 16278a1c4f6b), not from the stores as they stand now; the cache the r34 build itself used was not found locally. The control (366 of the 366 priced non-cash securities reproduced) shows the cache prices the same securities the served table priced. Settling read: one read-only get of the current gold-canonical-holdings and silver-canonical-prices objects for the date.

Whether the custodian's raw files (bronze zips) carry any price or market-value field that silver omits. Silver keeps every vendor column (commonwealth_portfolio_files.py:7-8), so the answer is read from silver schemas; the raw zips were not opened. Settling read: the header row of the raw Historical_Positions and transactions members in bronze.

What the trade-derived values (|Amount|/|Quantity|) mean per kind: for Fixed Income and Cash Equivalent the unit (percent of par or per unit) is not determined, and a trade price is not a close on the date. The build forbids carrying a price from another day, so the within-5-day and last-trade counts are the supply of observations, not a coverage the build could use.

Whether MDPF_SECHIST (PRD lines 220-221, where the ruled sources' prices land) already holds prices for any of the 459 securities. Not read: no sechist label appears on the served 2026-05-06 table and the build's --sechist option was not run. Settling read: the series' prefix under the builder address, one listing.

Whether the Yahoo files held locally (yahoo_census) were pulled for these CUSIPs: they are the price-basis census's files keyed by store ticker; 31 of the 32 reused-ticker securities have one. Their Close on the date was counted, not judged against the CUSIP.
The share of account VALUE the unpriced positions are (a null value cannot be summed); the counts here are securities and position rows only.
Why the stores start when they do (gold 2026-06-08; silver 2020-06-30 in the cached copies) is not established; only the dates were measured.

Unpriced securities without a symbol (253 of 459: Fixed Income 183, Cash Equivalent 50, Annuity 12, Equity 6, Alternative Investment 2) have no key by which a Yahoo request could be made; the CUSIP is their only identifier in the data read.
